title: What will be the closing value of the S&P 500 index on November 30, 2026?
description: The S&P 500 is a stock market index tracking 500 of the largest companies listed on US stock exchanges.
resolution_criteria: This question resolves as the official closing value of the S&P 500 index (ticker ^GSPC) on Monday, November 30, 2026, as reported by Yahoo Finance or another reliable source of market data.
